summary: Highly experienced Senior Software Engineer with 45+ years in software development and test automation, now specializing in AI-assisted software development and GenAI applications. Proven ability to build scalable platforms, implement ML pipelines, and develop full-stack solutions using Python, TypeScript, and Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Gemini). Adept at productionizing models, building APIs, and mentoring, with a strong background in robust system development and hardware-software integration.

experience.title: Chief Consulting Engineer
bullets: Led AI-assisted software development and GenAI applications, building full-stack products with TypeScript, Python, React, and Next.js, leveraging Vertex AI and Google Gemini for advanced functionalities.
Designed and implemented AI-powered tools, including a 'Hire Me' AI Tools Suite utilizing Vertex AI for job fit analysis, custom resume generation, and interactive interview simulations.
Developed scalable web applications with Google Cloud backend (Vertex AI, Firestore, Cloud Storage), demonstrating proficiency in cloud platform integration and API development.
Applied prompt engineering techniques with leading LLMs (Claude Code, ChatGPT, Perplexity.ai) for software development, testing, and documentation, showcasing expertise in GenAI workflows.
Explored and implemented advanced AI concepts, including a 'Tensor Logic' interactive demo bridging neural and symbolic AI with a Rust/Axum backend, aligning with distributed systems principles.

experience.title: Test Engineer III - Embedded Software
bullets: Developed and executed verification testing for embedded instrument software, including USB-based updates and regression tests, ensuring high-quality product releases.
Created API Reference documentation using Sphinx and managed technical content on Confluence, facilitating clear communication and knowledge transfer.
Proposed and implemented Quality of Service (QoS) plans for cellular radio testing, demonstrating strategic thinking in complex system validation.
Designed and implemented complete remote access for continuous integration and continuous real target testing, enabling efficient and comprehensive test coverage.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
bullets: Developed a highly object-oriented test framework in Python for automotive OTA firmware update testing, mediating between cloud servers and vehicular hardware.
Designed the framework for expansion and scalability with multi-level logging and stop-on-fail control, enhancing test execution robustness.
Implemented concurrent application log following and extensive YAML configuration for test parameterization, optimizing test efficiency and flexibility.

experience.title: Sr. Diagnostic Software Engineer
bullets: Co-designed and developed a test station for a Cooling Unit, including custom hardware and Python software for 5 BeagleBone Black microcomputers running Debian Linux.
Developed host production test programs within an existing Python framework, integrating custom calibration and control for sensors.
Created telemetry event data log visualization using numpy, pandas, and matplotlib, including time-series plots and cross-tabulation for status words.
Constructed SQL databases for parsed and cleaned telemetry data, enabling robust data analysis and correlation.
Developed environmental data collection and logging synchronous with system-level test logging in Python for correlated time-series analysis.

experience.title: Sr. Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and implemented hi-speed timing calibration for a 192-channel digital Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) instrument using C++.
Developed custom Python scripts for generating XML timing patterns, demonstrating early proficiency in Python for automation.
Co-designed generic parallel, binary search objects for efficient test execution and data processing.

experience.title: Sr. Test Program Engineer
bullets: Developed functional and performance testing for SSDs with SATA, SAS, and PCIe interfaces on Linux platforms using C and Perl.
Created a Linux PC-based test station platform with complete physical enumeration for JEDEC Endurance Testing, including oven integration.
Mentored a new college graduate in SSD test development, sharing expertise in test methodologies and software engineering best practices.

experience.title: Diagnostic Software Engineer
bullets: Ported UltraSPARC T1 and VF CPU POST to telco-oriented and NEBS-qualified chassis, ensuring hardware compatibility and reliability.
Ported online diagnostics for service processors running Linux, demonstrating expertise in embedded systems and diagnostics.
Closed over 20 bugs on an ethernet loopback test program across all Sun platforms, enhancing network diagnostic capabilities.

experience.title: Test Development Engineer
bullets: Developed custom test equipment and C software for performance verification of hi-speed source synchronous channels in ATE instruments (up to 3.2 Gb/sec).
Developed an on-line diagnostic for an Edge Measurement Calibration Subsystem with pico-second accuracy using a 3-dimensional linear regression algorithm.
Utilized Verilog co-simulation environment for early diagnostic development, demonstrating proficiency in hardware/software co-design.
